_comment: The first press in the Americas (#6559): Mexico City imprints, Juan Pablos 1539 onward, from the John Carter Brown Library's Mexican incunabula on IA.

PRODUCED BY: enumerate-dedupe-source.ts --ia-collection jcbmexicoincunables (87 NEW, 2026-10-11), then hand selection: every item to 1601, one copy per edition, plus five later landmarks (Hernández 1615, Alemán 1609, Bramón 1620, Huehuetlahtolli 1601, Echegoyan 1603). Post-1601 sermons and ephemera skipped.
language = first MARC language code of the edition (language-fields.md); languages[] when bilingual. MARC cai/nai for Michoacán items = Purépecha.
